metadata.api_cache_definition: First versus immediate repeat per Site/resource; server caches retained
metadata.automatic_prefetch: Content rail uses explicit hover/focus intent with 180 ms dwell and 1 s throttle; normal prefetch on other links remains; pre-initiation traffic is outside measured navigation
metadata.cold_definition: fresh browser context and HTTP cache; target Site absent from Next router cache; application/database caches retained
metadata.warm_definition: same browser context; previously visited target; no forced invalidation
metadata.session_policy: Independent real Keycloak browser sign-in before every cold/warm iteration; login is excluded from timings; each pair uses one active session
metadata.authentication_role: Site Administrator on 21 benchmark Sites; no platform role
metadata.sampling_warning: SMOKE: p95 is a small-sample diagnostic; use >=30 per scenario for acceptance.
metadata.interaction: Searchable Workspace dialog; discovery is included in switch timing
metadata.site_switch_policy: Preserve authorized section root; read caches scoped to session/Site/authorization; 30-second context lease, 5-minute inactive GC; mutable forms reset
metadata.cache_policy: PERF-005: scoped navigation controls plus PERF-004 30-second in-memory context/read lease, five-minute inactive GC; scoped reuse on Site return, disposal on session change and purge on Site authorization change
